notes.title: Garden In! - Update 1.4.0 - Second Anniversary Update!
notes.notes:
Hello gardeners!
We've been quietly pushing a couple of small fixes in the last few months to resolve a couple of bugs that kept popping up but we're happy to celebrate our second anniversary 🎂

[h2]🏆Master Gardener🏆[/h2]
We've added a new botanical mastery with two very important quality of life that we're sure you'll appreciate.

- 2 new tools to water and spray the plants in your garden
- 2 new trophies to keep in check the watering and bugs of grown up plants

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/b07fcf840e519b536f2e3bba22bca34a443acdc7.png[/img]

The two new tools are called the Watering Can + and the Bug Spray + ✨
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/866a0eee9cfc3d7e6159f65c5f41defe32037605.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/04bed273c9ad2bf13ba9cb47e6f09f99ecc27cf1.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/e10a596699c5bdb03a41f6c6875212b669c0ae5b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/90754d36ef738c76c45913e7a4118a90dc98e5a6.png[/img][/url]

Tired of watering each plant one by one? No problem!
With these new items you'll be able to water and spray quickly in a large area! Talk about efficency 👀

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/10d9baf82bfa3c5bfe0a11e28dcec08b46a634d5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/6d6aa7c4e26d45cc6863352c84b68e40c907886e.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/b1df10969312132453d311b61340177099f07372.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/4eaa6bb4600abd993339163ec181f658eb099952.png[/img][/url]

The trophies celebrate your achievement as a gardener but also keep in check the water level and spray on your fully grown plants! Making them less needy so that you can focus on your growing seedlings 🌱

We hope that these new items will helpful in your relaxing journey!

[b]⚙️Quality of Life⚙️[/b]

Updated the DLSS with the latest version and changed how presets works.

Dear friends, that's all for now, we hope that you'll be keeping growing plants, relaxing in your garden and enjoying yourself 💚

Thank you for all the support you've given us, that's all for now.
- The Dramatic Iceberg Team 🧊

notes.title: Garden In! - Update 1.3.0 - Anniversary Update!
notes.notes:
Hello gardeners!
We have reached an important milestone that we want to share with you as Garden In! turns one 🎂
To celebrate this journey, we prepared a little something for the first anniversary of Garden In! 🎉

[h2]🎂Anniversary🎂[/h2]
Let's start our celebration with some new plants for everyone and two peculiar backgrounds!
[list]
[*] 6 new plants to hybridize
[*] 2 new exclusive backgrounds
[i]They are already unlocked, so go check them out![/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/116e1dcc01fb29e99d140e17422c6188c4793810.png[/img]
[i]Just a sneak peek of two of the new plants 👀[/i]

[h2]🎁 Themed Packs 🎁[/h2]
It woulnd't be an update without a new Themed Pack for everyone to unlock!

[h3]💝Valentine💝[/h3]
Love is in the air, can you feel it? Grow some flowers, grab some chocolate and get fuzzy with your special someone!
[list]
[*] 6 new vases
[*] 12 new decorations
[*] 1 new background
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/9fd4e2d0e9c64f4e01e01a78a5e702d6d24834e4.png[/img]
A pink room for a pink heart ❣️

[h2]🌱Nicknames🌱[/h2]
We know no two plants are the same and each deserves to be cherished, that's why now you can give "Nicknames" to your favourite plants! How can you change their name? It's super easy, just focus on them by double clicking and then change their name in the text box! 

We hope this feature can help you feel closer to your green friends. ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/74b7f9ffc5a183f0559251788d3f1e3b0ff04264.png[/img]
[i]Nice to meet you Sandy!🌻[/i]

[h2]⚙️Quality of Life⚙️[/h2]
We have worked on some small QoL to improve the overall experience for everyone!
[list]
[*] Modified object placement behavior while using a controller to allow greater precision when zoomed in.
[*] Changed some fonts to improve readability
[*] Changed some icons to improve readability
[*] Improved the options menu navigation
[/list]
[h2]📖Artbook📖[/h2]
You waited long enough! The official Garden In! Artbook (or expanded Herbarium) is here! 
You can get it on the store page and read some interesting facts about the many different plants 🧐
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/0c2b852342c4165ee3028564183a6b12688c740c.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2720930/Garden_in_Artbook

[h2]🎹Original Soundtrack🎹[/h2]
You have listened for hours to the soundtrack and now you can get it and listen to it wherever you go! Isn't that amazing? Relax everywhere you go! 🎧
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/b979f3a101c643bf1b5ad1a7d847059980ae8f9c.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2720890/Garden_in_Original_Soundtrack

[h2]✨Garden In! Deluxe Edition✨[/h2]
Are you still hesitant to buy the game? Well, now you can get an amazing bundle with the game, the art book, and the soundtrack for a discounted price! Ain't that amazing? 🤩
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/8c1ee6515ec8fdd4a249f3a5db216fb642b0476f.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37762/Garden_In__Deluxe_Edition

[h2]✅Steam Deck Verified✅[/h2]
We know that a lot of players are already playing on the Steam Deck but now it's better than ever! Garden In! is officially Steam Deck Verified! So grab your console and start planting some seeds 🌱

We're so happy that you stuck with us all this time.
We hope that Garden In! will always be a calm, relaxing place for you to come back to.

Once again, thank you for playing Garden In!
-The Dramatic Iceberg Team 🧊

notes.title: Garden In! - Update 1.1.0 - The Halloween Update!
notes.notes:
Hello gardeners!
The spooky season is in full swing, there is no better time for a ghostly update! 👻

For the 1.1.0 update we have prepared a lot of cool things!
We've added a new feature called the [i]Botanical Mastery[/i] and some new things to be unlocked through it.

[h3]🏡Botanical Mastery🏡[/h3]
After unlocking the second room, you'll get a new section inside the Trophy menu called the [i]Botanical Mastery[/i]. 

Inside this section you can find the Plant of the day and the Themed Packs.
You can select which Themed Pack you want to unlock and each point you get by growing a plant, will slowly add up and help you unlock new plants and decorations!

You can change at any time which Themed Pack you are currently unlocking, so don't be overwhelmed!
Take your time and unlock everything!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/19529de6e0683d2e4522d790c0a522853a98f4f8.png[/img]

[b]🌻Plant of the day🌻[/b]
Each day everyone will get a new Plant of the day.
If you plant the seed and let it grown, you will get some additional points when it's fully grown!
But remember, this bonus is applied to the first five seedling you plant this way.

[b]🌽Cottagecore🌽[/b]
There is nothing better than going back to the countryside with some themed decorations.
[list]
[*] 6 new vases
[*] 5 new furniture
[*] 11 new decorations
[*] 1 new background
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/73e0b9b753876dc201ca5b67ab27a81bc27a63e9.png[/img]

[b]🎃Spooky Season🎃[/b]
The spookiest time of the year! Decorate your gardens with some ghostly furniture and some mystical new plants.
[list]
[*] 3 new plants
[*] 6 new vases
[*] 3 new furniture
[*] 9 new decorations
[*] 1 new background
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/946702abbd66f215448e206102e594c1e466367a.png[/img]

[h3]🌱Plants and Seeds🌱[/h3]
More combinations! 
Six new plants, two for each type, are obtainable by hybridizing the various seeds.
Check them out in your herbarium for more information about them!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/879e2653ef314cdb06587cbb344b122f45a40095.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/d32cc0113a7d07feea710e454c565a973ffb6ee7.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/14d6c0a67fcf6bc35807fc285b5b51a755ca1921.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/295442aa718a93fb0c5d8c9ebcbef2940aa8e509.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/f79e99a8e50c559824e57f5c111ca7cc5e54aec8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/916df2315a80682a7c2aaee67b56d5752102a993.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/b77e76a200b047fa56a803350b5a84dde1a17160.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/37c1c182db070d5013dee8280f5f3546e24e907c.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/854be35207bcfc93c7b213b73d367c755594a223.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/9c4cb3efefaebe9146cbb34b248010fa08fd2330.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/565cb5aca170b86c540ced3044e75173ed1a25f2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/922d021def2aac9dd266b789c794334b4a4060c3.png[/img][/url]

A little sneak peek of the different plants! Don't they all seem very nice? 👀

[h3]⚙️Quality of Life⚙️[/h3]

[b]🕹️Gamepad Support🕹️[/b]
Controller support has been added! You can plug your controller to your PC and it should automatically identify it and start playing comfortably.
The icons should also change to reflect the fact that the controller is being used.

[b]🖥️DLSS🖥️[/b]
One more thing we have done is adding the Deep Learning Super Sampling or DLSS for short by Nvidia (requires RTX 20-series and above) and AMD FSR.
It's a small thing but can help make the game run better on lower end computers.
If you don't know what this is, don't worry about it.

We still have more things prepared until the end of the year, so I hope you will stick with us in this cozy journey!

Thank you for playing Garden In!

-The Dramatic Iceberg Team 🧊

notes.title: Garden In! - Patch 1.0.8 + Future Plans
notes.notes:
Hello gardeners and thank you for your patience! 🌱

I know we have been quiet for a while now, but a lot of things happened, and it turns out, running a videogame studio is not as easy as we thought.

We're very sorry that this fix took way longer than intended; rest assured that we are still keeping a close eyes on the Steam forums for issues that arise.

[h3][b] 🌻Updates🌻 [/b][/h3]
- 📦 Added 10 new decorations
- 🪑 Added 3 new furniture items
[i]These new items are spread throughout the existing room progression , so if you've already completed the relevant rooms, you may find them already unlocked the next time you start the game.[/i]

No spoilers, boot up the game and see for yourself what they are.

[h3][b]🐛Bug Fixes🐛[/b][/h3]
- Fixed a bug where the menu's context text disappear while navigating locked items.
- Fixed an inventory's bug that created a page without props or furniture.
- Fixed the "Master Gardener" achievement requiring an incorrect number of plants to be completed.
- Fixed the "Every Single one" research displaying an incorrect amount of plants needed to be grown in the Garden.
- Fixed the "Hands in the Dirt", "Head in the Clouds", "Feet in the Water" achievements not requiring all the plants of their generation to be unlocked.

[h3][b]🕛Plans and Next Steps🕛[/b][/h3]

There is more content ready to go, more plants, more furniture, new decorations and some colorful backgrounds!
As a first sneak peek, this is the silhouette of one of the new plants that are coming in the update 1.1.0.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/2f18e571d74015fae3b553167bfc080e19646857.png[/img]

What type of plant do you think it is? It seems to be quite colorful! ✨

[h3][b]📖 Herbarium 📖[/b][/h3]

For all lovely gardeners who enjoyed our game, we have prepared a small art book / herbarium with all the different plants that we have created. It contains additional trivia and scientific facts about each of the plants within. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/6d1267cbd1796a88921eb0f4937a096b41f90f4a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/5092fdf9c0dc326cc3c7e21e7f4b96a3f0705d3c.jpg[/img]

These pages aren't finalized, we are still putting some finishing touches to them.
The herbarium will be available to purchase with our next update, so please be on the lookout for the news. 👀

[h3][b] ⚙️Extras ⚙️ [/b][/h3]

For all you wonderful Steam Deck players, we are working on getting the game verified with some small quality of life in order to make it run better. 🎮
In the meantime we have added controller support to make it easier to play.

We also are aware that some Linux users are having trouble running the game. 🐧
We are trying to replicate the issues but we are having a hard time detecting what might be the problem.
If anyone has more information about it, please do report it in the Forum.

Thank you for playing Garden In!

-The Dramatic Iceberg Team 🧊

notes.title: Garden In! Spring Update & Flash Sale
notes.notes:
🌱🌟 Hello Garden In! friends, we have the cutest and most exciting news for you! Our lovely game just got a MAJOR update that will make your green thumb wiggle with joy! 🌼👍

notes.title: Your Home #2
notes.notes:
Hello hello,

Welcome to the second Garden In! devlog.

Last time we took a look at some of our plants and the different types you'll find in the game.

Now we're going to talk a little bit about the rooms, the environments you'll decorate with the lovely greenery you'll be growing.

There are 4 rooms inside the game. 

Each with it's own intended purpose, but of course you can change, decorate and move enough things to shape it to your own liking. Let's start, shall we?

[b]The Studio[/b]
Also known as the Main Room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/03fd3bfeffb0c3a26abf343aee26ce8c53ac1370.png[/img]

It's meant to be very cozy, a normal room inside a house, it holds infinite possibilities!
A studio, a living room, a storage or that extra room in your house that you're not sure how to use...
It's the first room you're gonna settle in and it's definitely the one we're most attached to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/5c71037ceb012b66077603b3d0fce6aa550b976c.png[/img]

If you're wondering how it can be decorated. This is a taste of my Studio!
I liked the idea of creating a space where I would work but also relax. Working from my PC while surrounded by some of my favourite plants but with some extra space where I can just sit down and read a book in my peaceful room.

[b]The Balcony[/b]
It's the smallest room in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/8080d4e6e7cca09331281af0a0c84beb240a32e1.png[/img]

There's nothing better than taking a breath of fresh air out in a lovely balcony.
Stretch your legs and let's be honest, it's the perfect place to enjoy a sunny day or a peaceful night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/f3aa39fe31bdd05ddb4c89d06148163da51ff587.png[/img]

I like to fill mine with hybridization vases. They remind me of the large vases my mom had in our terrace, so they feel fitting to place here. I imagine myself sipping a cold drink and watching a colorful summer night go by.

[b]The Greenhouse[/b]
Decorated with windows and glasses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/714353ec3f84c5f2b9fdc6a227bce450e44b596b.png[/img]

It's quite the big room! It's perfect to fit all kinds of plants, vases and whatnot.
It might seem quite cluttered but if you move some of the tables around you can change quite a lot how it looks like!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/29999698ad59274c9654dc2816f308b41fe6da1c.png[/img]

For example, I didn't want to have a greenhouse / laboratory but something like a storage room or a general store. I wasn't sure which one to do, so I did both! I moved some cabinets and shelfs, filled with all kinds of decorations and tada! I created a general storage room. I think it turned out quite well.

[b]The Garden[/b]
Sometimes closed door can't quite beat open air.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/ad8c44fbb7b1916383175490942529eadcc0cad1.png[/img]

Quite the garden, don't you think? The small waterfall is my favourite thing.
If you were bored of being confined in a house, this might just do the trick for you.

There are a lot of things that you can do here. So, instead of showing you what I have done, why don't we all just imagine together our dream garden? Filled to the brim with plants? Or neatly organized with furnitures and cute decorations? With a sunny sky? Under a starry night? Or during a beatiful sunset?

When you're done imagining it, why don't you share it with everyone else down in the comments?
It might become a reality!

Thank you for following the devlopment of Garden In!, for all of the lovely people that got an early access to the game, don't worry the fixes are flying your way!

Don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam and follow us for more updates and news!
-

notes.title: Lush gardens from your dreams are soon becoming a reality
notes.notes:
Growing plants and gardens takes time, devotion, love, water, the right kind of soil, sometimes some fertilisers. No wonder we can’t keep our plants alive ourselves, it takes a lot. But not anymore, as Garden In! is coming out in early 2023! In this cute and relaxing sandbox game you grow gardens from your dreams with no stress.

Garden In! is made by an Italian studio Dramatic Iceberg. The game is the studio’s first commercial video game title. The game will be released by Bonus Stage Publishing on PC and Nintendo Switch early 2023. The game was featured in Wholesome Games and Guerrilla Collective in June 2022.

The game starts in one room in which you are tasked to decorate to your liking. Your room is basically a perfect little sandbox in which you can move furniture around, paint the environment, and most importantly: grow plants. A lot of plants.

At first you have a few seeds available, you can plant them in soil, water, rocks, and you have a few pots to choose from. But as you advance, combine different seeds and try out different growing conditions, your seed library will grow and grow, until you are the most advanced horticulturist in the world. You also unlock new rooms and areas by playing the game further.

“We started making the game because none of our team was able to keep their plants alive. We then decided we needed to learn some gardening skills, and just like that was the idea for the game born”, says Tommaso Verde from Dramatic Iceberg.

Garden In! is something we all need in our lives nowadays – relaxing and beautiful, with no worries or stress of the outside world. “We’re extremely happy to work with the publishing of Garden In because in the midst of the busy world we all need some time to relax in our gardens. Also what makes us happy is that thanks to our partner Double Jump Capital we’re able to maximise the production quality of the game with their investment in the game.”

Brett M. Brown, Managing Partner of Double Jump Capital said: “We are extremely excited to partner with Dramatic Iceberg and Bonus Stage Publishing to bring such a fun game to market.  We see enormous potential in supporting such an innovative, entertaining and enjoyable game and look forward to the success of Garden In!”

Stay tuned for the soon to be announced release date and new content revelations by wishlisting and following the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1953860/Garden_In/.

notes.title: Your Seedlings #1
notes.notes:
Hello Friends!

Welcome to our first developer update about Garden In!

The game isn't out yet but we're too excited not to talk about it, so we will be sharing a bit about the development and some cool screenshots made by us, the Icebergs! 

I'm sure you have many questions about the game since we have released so little material about it, so let's talk a little bit more about it.

[b]Garden In! is an idle experience about growing your own virtual garden.[/b]

You do so by choosing a pot, filling it with soil and plant a seed.
From there you will have to take care of it, watering it, keeping it safe from insects and giving it much love.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/ea0dfa26a5daf9a51de5922e541581f9a1f2b359.gif[/img]

[b]Did you know? There are three different generations of plants![/b]

[b]Ground[/b]
These are the most classic type of plants, they absorb the nutrients in the ground and extend their roots deep underground. They grow with soil in ground pots and require to bury its seed deep within it.

[b]Water[/b]
Quite differently, water seeds require a lot of [i]water[/i] to grow. They are totally different from algae and have learned to float on water. In order to grow, they will require a water pot to be filled with a specific type of water.

[b]Air[/b]
Avoiding dirt and soil, these plants absorb nutrients through their leaves, not their roots, which instead they use to anchor themselves to rocks or objects. They require its seed to be placed in air pot on top of of a pile of rocks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/487b6f04ae5a0131c1eab0a0a014613ecf4e17f8.png[/img]

[b]The plant business is not over, you can also bring compatible seeds together and obtain new ones![/b]

By putting two seedlings in a bigger and larger hybridization vase and then fully growing them, a new seed will spring forward. But remember, only if they are compatible. 

Since the space is so little, the plants growing will be a bit smaller. 

Different generation of seeds cannot be combined one with another, this is mostly because they don’t share the same “environment”, no water seed can grow on hard soil. 

[spoiler]Yes, we know this isn't how it works but it's a videogame so let's just say it's green magic ;) [/spoiler]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282744/deb343869ecd06acd4bf206aa7f5d6d1a7439699.png[/img]
